hypothesis: A funded campaign that beats the frozen CSI 300 over both the first five and ten sessions, while remaining positive in absolute terms at session ten, identifies compoundable ownership rather than a broad-pool distractor.

fixed_rule.state: positive stock-minus-benchmark excess log return at both reviews and positive absolute stock return at the full review
fixed_rule.outcome_label: actual closed-campaign cash PnL after the fixed review

advance_rule: In every scope both states must have at least three closed reviewed campaigns; quality-state median PnL must be positive and its win rate must exceed the false state; it must retain at least 50% of reviewed positive PnL while the false state contains at least 50% of reviewed negative-PnL magnitude.

ledger.episode_return_basis: cash PnL divided by actual buy notional
cash PnL divided by actual buy notional
cash PnL divided by actual buy notional
